info.name: Spiko Distributor Distributor investor contracts API
info.description: The Distributor API allows third parties like SaaS providers, fintechs or Web3 companies to distribute the Spiko Funds to their customers. With this API, you can programmatically manage investors, send subscription and redemption orders, and access real-time portfolio information.

item.name: Get the fees paid for the given distributor investor contract

request.description:
**Retrieve the fees paid for the given distributor investor contract.**

- Returns an array of paid fees both in amount and in number of shares, sorted by day.
- `from` and `to` query parameters are optional and used to filter the results by day range.
